title: How Much Have They Grown?

readiness.math: measuring height with a repeated unit; comparing; difference (older)

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Do you remember measuring our beans? They have been drinking the rain and soaking up the sun.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Let's measure them again with the blocks, and see how much they have grown.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Stack blocks beside each plant until the stack is just as tall.
steps.question: tallest

older.question: difference
older.prompt: Measure each plant with the blocks. Then we'll compare them.

feedback.all_good: Look how tall they are now!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: They grew a little every day, even when we couldn't see it. Growing takes patience.

journal_line: I measured the beans again. They had grown taller!
unavailable_text: The beans need to be measured once before we can see how much they've grown.
